factorial_ablations.name: Denominator Guard (δ=0.002, floor=0.001)
factorial_ablations.legacy_treatment: Unguarded division, negative BOA reflectances unclipped
factorial_ablations.defect_mechanism_addressed: 598 fitting pixels (0.03%) caused 98.53% of NDWI variance explosion (+8.25x sigma), compressing real breach signals to zero
factorial_ablations.impact_on_detection: Restores authentic variance scale, allowing score C post-event response to emerge (+1.0906)

factorial_ablations.name: Focused Lake ROI (160x160 px, 10.24 km²)
factorial_ablations.sr1_remediated: 160x160 px window centered on lake basin, 16x16 px patches (320m)
factorial_ablations.defect_mechanism_addressed: Dilution: 1.67 km² lake breach represented <4% of pixels in quadrant; quadrant averaging washed out breach signal into alpine terrain
factorial_ablations.impact_on_detection: Lake tokens occupy 36% of ROI patches, isolating water loss from mountains

factorial_ablations.name: Location-Matched Reference Pool (±60 days DOY)
factorial_ablations.legacy_treatment: Global nearest-neighbor across any spatial token in scene
factorial_ablations.sr1_remediated: Nearest neighbor constrained strictly to same patch coordinates within seasonal window
factorial_ablations.defect_mechanism_addressed: False matching: drained lake bed patches were matched to background rock patches in reference scenes, masking anomaly
factorial_ablations.impact_on_detection: Forces comparison against historical lake water state, detecting drainage

factorial_ablations.name: Dependency-Safe Patch Masking
factorial_ablations.legacy_treatment: Single-channel masking allowing other bands to leak input state
factorial_ablations.sr1_remediated: All 5 channels masked simultaneously per target patch token
factorial_ablations.defect_mechanism_addressed: Information leakage across spectral channels during autoencoding
factorial_ablations.impact_on_detection: Ensures true representation learning without shortcut reconstruction

factorial_ablations.name: Lean Capacity & Cosine Training (d=64, 4 heads, 207k params)
factorial_ablations.defect_mechanism_addressed: 51% cross-seed variance and severe overfitting on small 48-scene corpus
factorial_ablations.impact_on_detection: Cross-seed variance reduced to <0.5% (val loss 0.3835–0.4741 across 5 seeds)

factorial_ablations.name: Static Geomorphic Zone Conditioning (Zones 0, 1, 2)
factorial_ablations.sr1_remediated: Zone 0 Core Water, Zone 1 Moraine Buffer ≤500m, Zone 2 Background
factorial_ablations.defect_mechanism_addressed: Inability to verify spatial localization of anomalies
factorial_ablations.impact_on_detection: Enables Estimand E4 Zone Contrast (+3.5712 contrast at breach site)
